name: Flappy maman
storyline:
In the quiet, misty heart of Brittany, Maman was enjoying what was supposed to be a peaceful evening—a warm cup of coffee, the soothing hum of her favorite soap opera, and the comforting purr of Harleen, her notoriously cryptic cat. But Harleen was no ordinary feline. While stepping across Maman’s glowing screen, the mischievous cat inadvertently typed a long-lost secret code into a forgotten arcade app. In an instant, the living room dissolved into a vortex of swirling neon light, sugar-fueled chaos, and electric gothic thunder.

Maman found herself thrust into the unpredictable world of Flappy Maman, a surreal nightmare-dimension where the laws of physics and common sense no longer applied. Armed with nothing but her stubborn Breton spirit and an uncanny ability to defy gravity, she must navigate a bizarre gauntlet of floating ancient dolmens, glowing vape pipes, towering stacks of crepes, and fluttering skulls. Every jump is a leap of faith through a kaleidoscope of unexpected hazards, where a single misstep means crashing into the void.

To make matters worse, the dimension itself is completely unstable. At any second, a sudden Golden Event can turn the sky into shimmering gold, or a wild Rainbow Event can multiply her score while showering the realm in sweet candy particles. Strange music tracks echo through the ether—ranging from heartfelt accordion melodies to erratic eurodance—dictating the chaotic pulse of her endless flight.

Hovering high above the madness, the omnipresent gaze of Harleen keeps track of every attempt. Maman isn’t just flying to survive; she is competing against interdimensional rivals for the ultimate crown atop the Daily Leaderboard. Along her journey, she unlocks legendary skins, transforming her look into everything from a Dia de los Muertos skull to a bat-wielding vigilante.

With every tap, Maman fights her way through unpredictable traps, secret score multipliers, and absurd Easter eggs. She won't stop floating until she breaks every record, conquers the leaderboard, and finally makes it back in time for her evening cappuccino.
summary:
Flappy Maman is a chaotic and funny mobile arcade game inspired by the classic Flappy Bird formula, with a dark, colorful, and completely ridiculous twist.

Take control of Maman and try to fly through a series of strange obstacles without crashing. Tap the screen to make your character jump, dodge the obstacles, and survive for as long as possible to achieve the highest score.

But Flappy Maman is much more than a simple endless-flying game. Every run can bring unexpected surprises, random events, secret codes, Easter eggs, special effects, and crazy references. Players can discover different skins, unlock funny effects, trigger special events, and compete for a place on the daily leaderboard.

The game also features a daily ranking system, user accounts, VIP skins, special events such as the Rainbow Event and Golden Event, music choices, secret codes, and random visual effects. Some events can multiply your score, while hidden bonuses and Easter eggs can completely change the atmosphere of a run.

Choose your favorite character, pick your music, enter a secret code, and get ready to see how far you can go.

Flappy Maman is simple to play, impossible to predict, and designed to turn every attempt into a chaotic little adventure.
